title: Watersound 41 N Founders Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $30 per day.- Unparalleled outdoor pool oasis- Elevator- 4-passenger golf cart- Professionally decorated- From March 1st to October 31st, 2024, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Nestled on the Emerald Coast, 41 N. Founders Lane is a stunning 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom home that sleeps 14 in WaterSound. Known for its winding boardwalks and rolling dunes, this picturesque community near the Gulf of Mexico offers multiple pools, and a puttering park. Guests will fall in love with the indulgent private pool and sweeping views from the 4-story lookout tower.Warmth and luxury abound inside the first-floor great room of the Main House, where wide-plank walnut floors stretch below 200-year-old wooden beams. After an adventurous day, wind down in the living space—perfectly arranged for a movie night with 2 plush sofas, 2 matching armchairs, a 65” Smart TV, and Sonos soundbar. The enormous chef’s kitchen hosts high-end appliances and a 14’ island that seats 6—a prime spot for a spread of snacks or a morning brunch. For group dinners, an elegant dining room with a 10-person table sits to the side. A comfortable guest bedroom with a king bed is on this floor, with more accommodations upstairs. Outside, a covered living area overlooks the private courtyard and pool. Plan a barbecue feast on the propane grill and an afternoon lounging on the sun shelf running the length of the pool.On the second floor, discover 2 guest bedrooms with king beds.An additional hangout spot awaits on the third floor, with a kitchenette, couch, and 55” Smart TV. There are 2 guest bedrooms—the first with 1 queen bed and the second with 2. On the furnished lookout tower, head up the spiral staircase for a bird’s eye view of the neighborhood. Savor a cold drink at the bar-height table for 4 or curl up with a book on the oversized porch swing.Tucked away in the Carriage House is a kitchenette, living area with a Smart TV, and a guest bedroom with a king bed.Indulge in a tranquil WaterSound vacation at 41 N. Founders Lane. Parking for 3 vehicles, along with 7 complimentary adult bikes and a 4-passenger golf cart, makes exploring easy. Book this impressive home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only THIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Please note that there are 2 golf carts on this property. The red cart with the number 440 is the only one for guest use.

Founders Lane is a stunning 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom home that sleeps 14 in WaterSound. Known for its winding boardwalks and rolling dunes, this picturesque community near the Gulf of Mexico offers multiple pools, and a puttering park. Guests will fall in love with the indulgent private pool and sweeping views from the 4-story lookout tower. Warmth and luxury abound inside the first-floor great room of the Main House, where wide-plank walnut floors stretch below 200-year-old wooden beams. Outside, a covered living area overlooks the private courtyard and pool. Plan a barbecue feast on the propane grill and an afternoon lounging on the sun shelf running the length of the pool. There are 2 guest bedrooms—the first with 1 queen bed and the second with 2. On the furnished lookout tower, head up the spiral staircase for a bird’s eye view of the neighborhood. Savor a cold drink at the bar-height table for 4 or curl up with a book on the oversized porch swing. Tucked away in the Carriage House is a kitchenette, living area with a Smart TV, and a guest bedroom with a king bed. Indulge in a tranquil WaterSound vacation at 41 N. Founders Lane. Parking for 3 vehicles, along with 7 complimentary adult bikes and a 4-passenger golf cart, makes exploring easy. Book this impressive home today!
